cases.description: Microsoft's documented worked example: the hyperbolic cosine of 4
cases.expected_note: Microsoft's page publishes this example's result as 27.308233. Independently derived from the documented formula cosh(x) = (e^x + e^-x)/2: math.cosh(4) = 27.308232836016487, and (math.exp(4)+math.exp(-4))/2 gives the same to machine precision -> 27.308233 at 6 dp

cases.description: Microsoft's documented worked example: the hyperbolic cosine of e, the base of the natural logarithm
cases.expected_note: Microsoft's page publishes this example's result as 7.6101251. Independently derived: math.cosh(math.e) = 7.610125138662288 -> 7.6101251 at 7 dp
From the documented formula (e^0 + e^0)/2 = (1+1)/2 = 1 exactly. cosh is bounded below by 1, so this is also its minimum

cases.description: The hyperbolic cosine of -4, which must equal that of +4
cases.expected_note: cosh is an even function: the documented formula (e^x + e^-x)/2 is unchanged when x is replaced by -x, so COSH(-4) must return exactly the documented COSH(4) value of 27.308233. Verified independently: math.cosh(-4) = 27.308232836016487, bit-identical to math.cosh(4)
